import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def to_float(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

# Totals
tot_rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":to_float(tot_rev_tw),"formula":"sum(Revenue_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LW","value":to_float(tot_rev_lw),"formula":"sum(Revenue_LW)"})
if not np.isnan(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LY","value":to_float(tot_rev_ly),"formula":"sum(Revenue_LY)"})

if tot_rev_lw and not np.isnan(tot_rev_lw) and tot_rev_lw != 0:
    wow = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_lw) / tot_rev_lw * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":to_float(wow,1),"formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LW))/sum(Revenue_LW)*100"})

if tot_rev_ly and not np.isnan(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    yoy = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_ly) / tot_rev_ly * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":to_float(yoy,1),"formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LY))/sum(Revenue_LY)*100"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"TW","value":to_float(tot_units_tw),"formula":"sum(Units_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"LW","value":to_float(tot_units_lw),"formula":"sum(Units_LW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"TW","value":to_float(tot_orders_tw),"formula":"sum(Orders_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"LW","value":to_float(tot_orders_lw),"formula":"sum(Orders_LW)"})

# Top 5 entities by revenue TW (rank, revenue, share)
top5 = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
for _, row in top5.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":to_float(row['Revenue_TW']),"formula":"Revenue_TW"})
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Share_Pct', np.nan)):
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"share","period":"TW","value":to_float(row['Share_Pct'],1),"formula":"Share_Pct"})
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Rank', np.nan)):
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"rank","period":"TW","value":to_float(row['Rank'],0),"formula":"Rank"})

# Biggest WoW gainer and loser
wow_df = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct'])
if not wow_df.empty:
    gainer = wow_df.loc[wow_df['WoW_Pct'].idxmax()]
    loser = wow_df.loc[wow_df['WoW_Pct'].idxmin()]
    facts.append({"entity":gainer['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":to_float(gainer['WoW_Pct'],1),"formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LW)/Revenue_LW*100"})
    facts.append({"entity":loser['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":to_float(loser['WoW_Pct'],1),"formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LW)/Revenue_LW*100"})

# Biggest YoY gainer and loser
yoy_df = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct'])
if not yoy_df.empty:
    gainer_y = yoy_df.loc[yoy_df['YoY_Pct'].idxmax()]
    loser_y = yoy_df.loc[yoy_df['YoY_Pct'].idxmin()]
    facts.append({"entity":gainer_y['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":to_float(gainer_y['YoY_Pct'],1),"formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LY)/Revenue_LY*100"})
    facts.append({"entity":loser_y['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":to_float(loser_y['YoY_Pct'],1),"formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LY)/Revenue_LY*100"})

# Top share entity
share_df = df.dropna(subset=['Share_Pct'])
if not share_df.empty:
    top_share = share_df.loc[share_df['Share_Pct'].idxmax()]
    facts.append({"entity":top_share['Entity'],"metric":"share","period":"TW","value":to_float(top_share['Share_Pct'],1),"formula":"Share_Pct"})

# Limit to 25 facts
facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
